Working with messages

A flow passes messages between nodes. A message is a plain object with a set of properties.

Messages usually carry a payload property.

{ "payload": "hello" }

Understanding the structure of a message

The debug sidebar shows the structure of each message.

Changing message properties

The change node sets, moves or deletes properties. Older guides are at the archive.

Moving message properties

Moving a property removes it from the old location.
